title: 通过事实-启发式-情感状态强制提升大语言模型行为一致性
summary: 提出认知内核模型(CKM)，在提示层强制LLM将输入分为事实、启发式和情感三类，以降低决策不一致性。在26个模型、37403次观察中，CKM将决策翻转率降低82%，且效果随采样随机性增大而增强。不提升推理正确性，但可测量并部分改善行为一致性。
summary_en: Proposes Cognitive Kernel Model (CKM), a prompt-level state-enforcement layer that forces LLMs to separate input into Fact, Heuristic, and Emotion roles. Across 26 models and 37,403 observations, CKM reduces decision-flip rate by 82%, with effect growing under sampling stochasticity. Does not improve reasoning correctness but measurably improves behavioral consistency.
